subcategory_text: Develop a process to evaluate service providers who hold sensitive data or are responsible for an enterprise's critical IT platforms or processes to ensure these providers are protecting those platforms and data appropriately.
implementation_examples: IG1: Inventory service providers; assess security posture
IG2: Monitor provider security; require incident reporting
IG3: Conduct on-site audits; continuous monitoring of providers
assessment_objectives: Determine whether provider security is monitored.
